key_entities: could not fetch from promisor remote
propositions: Bridge git push abandons after a single transport fault (TLS, DNS, timeout) instead of retrying, leaving unpushed commits on the runner
The push retry logic in push.py retries only non-fast-forward failures; all other non-zero returns including transient transport errors are terminal on first failure

Transport faults (certificate verification, connection reset, git timeout, RPC failures, promisor fetch failures) are misclassified as permanent rule violations and receive zero retries instead of bounded retry attempts with backoff
The merge recovery leg can fail with merge-recovery-blocked due to promisor on-demand fetch transport errors on blob:none partial clones, also receiving zero retries
Push failure classification and retry logic must be split into a separate push_classify.py module to stay within the 800-LOC hard cap while adding transport retry and backoff logic
